name: keyhole-desktop
description: Keyhole desktop app (Electron) — also publishes @keyhole/core and @keyhole/shared

scripts.build:libs: npm run build --workspace @keyhole/core && npm run build --workspace @keyhole/shared
scripts.test: npm run build:libs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:libs && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:app: npm run build:libs && npm run dev --workspace @keyhole/app
scripts.publish:libs: npm run build:libs && npm publish --workspace @keyhole/core && npm publish --workspace @keyhole/shared
